messages:
Noah (Product Marketing): Brainstorm: a sales one-pager that positions Redwood for banks and healthcare — focus on decision flow: hosted -> dedicated -> private. Keep it skimmable for exec buyers.
Priya (Growth): Love it. We should include a compact benchmark callout: typical p95 latencies and example cost delta for ded vs hosted. Call them 'typical production profiles'.
Evan (Field AE): From customer trials: Dedicated reduced tail latency and gave predictable throughput. For regulated customers, Private + KMS is the requirement. Also mention SOC2 + ISO.
Clara (Design): I'll do an A/B on layout: A) three-column features vs B) timeline-on-right. Which tone? enterprise formal or developer friendly?
Noah (Product Marketing): Go enterprise formal but keep callouts in plain language — exec summary, technical callouts, onboarding checklist, CTA.
ops-bot: Note: upcoming webinar slot on 2026-05-12 at 10:00 PT booked.
Priya (Growth): CTA: 'Schedule a compliance review' on the landing; for PDF CTA: 'Contact sales'. Capture industry + compliance level on the form so we can route leads.
Evan (Field AE): For routing: leads with 'HIPAA' or 'PCI' tags -> Security Solutions queue; others -> standard AE. Also escalate if deal >$100k ARR.
Noah (Product Marketing): Messaging draft: headline, three bullets (security controls, SLA and uptime, deployment flexibility), a compact benchmark strip, onboarding steps, legal footnote.
Clara (Design): Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/enterprise-onepager — will upload two variants by EOD Monday.
Priya (Growth): Also add a short webinar narrative: 'How Redwood secures regulated LLMs' with customer quote, 10-min demo, 15-min panel. Use it as gated content behind the landing.
Noah (Product Marketing): Great. I'll stitch copy for both PDF and landing. Evan — can you give one short customer quote we can use? Just 1-2 lines.
Evan (Field AE): Sure: 'Redwood gave us predictable latency and the controls we needed to pass our SOC2 audit.' — happy to attribute to Financial Services Pilot.
Noah (Product Marketing): Solid. Timeline: comps by Clara Monday, copy + benchmark bullets by Tuesday, landing build by Priya midweek, legal review in parallel.
Priya (Growth): I'll set up tracking for lead routing and AB tests. Also run a small paid social push targeted at cloud security managers after launch.
Noah (Product Marketing): Thanks team — let's meet Thursday to review final PDF and landing before publish. :rocket:
